title: Scaling Up Polyclinics' Capacity to Accommodate More Walk-in Patients with Urgent Conditions
what_it_is: Scaling Up Polyclinics' Capacity to Accommodate More Walk-in Patients with Urgent Conditions

sections.label: Walk-in patients and polyclinic expansion
sections.summary: Urgent walk-in patients are attended to, others may book or go to a GP, and more polyclinics are opening.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As for walk-in patients without appointments, those requiring urgent medical attention will be attended to, those not requiring urgent medical attention may be asked to book an appointment or seek treatment at a nearby general practitioner (GP) clinic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are continuing to expand our network of polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We opened Bukit Panjang, Eunos and Kallang Polyclinics in end 2021 and another two polyclinics in Sembawang and Tampines North are slated to open later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Khatib Polyclinic will open in 2024 and Serangoon and Tengah Polyclinics in 2025.

sections.label: Triage of walk-in patients
sections.summary: Walk-in patients are triaged and assessed, including their frailty, age and mobility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my original answer, the walk-in residents, the walk-in patients are triaged and assessed, and part of that assessment will, indeed, be their state of frailty, and their age and their mobility are considered as part of that assessment.

sections.label: Seniors and online appointment booking
sections.summary: Some elderly residents struggle with online booking, slots fill quickly, and seniors form a high proportion of polyclinic workload.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Some may be quite elderly, less able to go online, less able to quickly click to secure the appointment when the bookings open.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: I have residents who tell me that, for some polyclinics, the online slots are used up within half an hour of the online booking starting on some days.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For his first supplementary question, I do not have the data with me about the proportions of seniors that are attending now as compared to historical data.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would be happy to provide it if he would like to file a separate Parliamentary Question.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But, in general, as I engage with the polyclinic staff and the clinicians who provide these services, it is quite clear that a very high proportion of their workload is, indeed, the seniors.

sections.label: Integrating CHAS GP clinics online
sections.summary: A suggestion to integrate CHAS GP clinics into an online booking system will be studied to improve access to primary care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: On his suggestion about integration of the CHAS GP clinics into an online booking system, it is a suggestion worth studying and we will, indeed, look to see how we can improve access to primary care services for residents.
